story.title: Our Story
story.text1: Kamancha Restaurant opened its doors in 2018 in the vibrant heart of Yerevan, on Tumanyan Street 23. Named after the ancient Armenian string instrument, our restaurant is a celebration of Armenian culture, music, and gastronomy.
story.text2: We are proud to be ranked #3 on TripAdvisor in Yerevan, with over 75,000 Instagram followers who join us on our culinary journey. Our chefs use only the finest local ingredients to craft dishes that honor centuries-old Armenian recipes.

founder.title: Meet the Founder
founder.name: Areg Manukyan
founder.bio: Areg, known as @restormania on social media, is a passionate culinary artist who dedicated his life to preserving and reimagining Armenian cuisine. With over 15 years of experience, he has made Kamancha a destination for food lovers worldwide.
